summary:
Fixed both validation failures: the grid tile's set-name (and card-name) `

` now carries a `title` attribute so the full text is visible on hover instead of being silently ellipsis-clipped, and I moved `playwright.config.ts` into `client/` and installed `@playwright/test` at the repo root (removing the duplicate copy from `client/`) so `bun run test:e2e` actually resolves and runs `scripts/cards-set-name.pw.ts` instead of failing with `ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND` — verified live that all 3 ARCA-50 e2e tests and all 118 `bun test` cases pass. — researched from the venture's brain (semantic), planned as a PRP with 4 validation gate(s) (written), then passed on round 2 of 2 (earlier rounds failed — round 1: validation gates not met — edge cases: a card with an unusually long set name renders without the set name being illegibly clipped or breaking the row/tile layout (grid tile set-name

keeps unmitigated `truncate` (no title attr/wrap); DOM check with a long name (scrollWidth 226 > clientWidth 177) shows ellipsis mid-word cutoff with no way to see full name, and diff made no fix despite PRP flagging this exact case); coverage: an automated test asserts `set_name` is present in `/api/cards` and `/api/cards/:id` responses, and an automated test asserts `CardsPage` and `CardDetailPage` render the set name, so a future regression is caught by CI rather than manual QA (API coverage (modules/cards/handlers.test.ts) passes via `bun test`, but the added UI test (scripts/cards-set-name.pw.ts) cannot execute: root playwright.config.ts imports @playwright/test which is only installed under client/node_modules (no workspace hoisting), so the documented `bun run test:e2e` fails with ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND before any test runs)) against them plus tests, /review review pass (0 critical) and /qa: Booted backend (:3001) + frontend (:5173) with seeded data. Verified API responses (/api/cards, /api/cards/sets, /api/cards/:id) include set_name matching the new frontend response-shape expectations. Ran the branch's own Playwright e2e spec (scripts/cards-set-name.pw.ts): grid view, list view, and card detail header all show a non-empty set name (3/3 passed; one run hit a beforeEach signup timeout on first attempt, unrelated to the set-name feature, and passed cleanly on retry). Also ran modules/cards/handlers.test.ts (2/2 pass, set_name present on list and detail endpoints)..
